bibliographic.title: Dust & Data
bibliographic.author: xielu
bibliographic.description:
Cas, a former informant for bounty hunters, thought he had hidden from his past forever among the dust of Backwater-3. But the past has finally shown up at his gate, with blaster in hand and with one question: what on his ranch is marked as "EXTREMELY DANGEROUS"?

Dust & Data is a comedic and cozy interactive fiction set in a space western universe, where agricultural cybernetics blend with cosmic country music.

Immerse yourself in an atmosphere where:
  • The air smells of wasteland dust and machine oil;
  • Old tape decks play blues and country tunes;
  • And robots are full-fledged family members.

Step into the role of Cas to:
    Put the pompous bounty hunter, Wild Coyote, in his place;
  • Interact with a cast of unique robot companions—from the grumpy Bill to the naive Cutie;
  • Unravel a mystery that has the entire Galaxy on the hunt.


Creator: B&D Institute student of Game Design department
